summary.text: Separation Song is Feng Jiu Ge's immortal killer move that separates Gu worms from each other so battlefield moves, Immortal Gu Houses, and formations fall apart.

claims.text: Against Wu Yong’s immortal battlefield four clear transforming winds, Feng Jiu Ge sings a soft sound path killer move that still reaches through Wu Yong’s defenses and stirs separation grief in him. The Gu worms that form the battlefield are not destroyed, yet they leave each other and stop cooperating, so the battlefield disintegrates and Wu Yong takes heavy backlash. The same song then shakes the rank eight Immortal Gu House Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building toward disintegration, showing rank eight level power, and Wu Yong retreats after Fang Yuan buys Feng Jiu Ge an opening. Wu Yong and Fang Yuan first read the cast as pinning Feng Jiu Ge in place; he then flies aside and proves that immobility was a feint.

Feng Jiu Ge names the immortal killer move Separation Song and uses it again at range against Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building. The song has no offensive power; Gu worms it removes are put back, and Wu Yong can retreat to repair and reinforce the House whenever separation goes too far.

Through song warrior the move can become a separation song warrior that breaks Bai Ning Bing’s penetrating ice blade; separation song can separate everything, including immortal killer moves. Among four offensive songs it stands with green jade song, heaven and earth song, and submission song.

At Lang Ya blessed land he unleashes Separation Song as a trump card, the best method to break apart immortal formations and Immortal Gu Houses; earlier it nearly dismantled Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building. The silver giant ancient battle formation and the allied immortal Gu formation are affected. Originally he could not move while using Separation Song; after later improvement he can move freely while casting it.
Among seven songs then held, Separation Song is a major-fight trump card with green jade song, heaven and earth song, and submission song.

Song warrior can turn Separation Song into a clone. When he uses Separation Song on Lang Ya’s super Gu formation it starts to break apart; the song still has no offensive power, yet it can break up any Gu formation, and Fang Yuan’s many layers mean each cast only strips an outer layer.

Feng Jiu Ge uses Separation Song as his signature killer move, described as countering Immortal Gu Houses and immortal formations; Fang Yuan’s modified formation extinguishes the song before it reaches the core.

Inside yama battlefield, Separation Song can break apart immortal formations, but the Immortal Gu that sustain the battlefield sit inside Fang Yuan’s sovereign immortal aperture, so the song cannot affect that interior and is useless there.
